What is my skin types

To determine your skin type, you can perform a simple test at home. Wash your face with a gentle cleanser and leave it bare for about 30 minutes. 

- If your skin feels oily or looks shiny, you may have **oily skin**.
- If it feels tight or dry, you may have **dry skin**.
- If some areas are oily (usually the T-zone) and others are dry, you may have **combination skin**.
- If your skin feels comfortable without excess oil or dryness, it is likely **normal**.

For a more personalized assessment, consider completing the skin analysis on the Cure app, where your concerns will be reviewed, and a suitable care plan will be recommended based on your skin needs.
Sensitive skin means

What is my skin type

You can determine your skin type by performing a simple test at home. Wash your face with a gentle cleanser and leave it bare for about 30 minutes. 

- If your skin feels oily or looks shiny, you may have oily skin.
- If it feels tight or dry, you may have dry skin.
- If some areas are oily (usually the T-zone) and others are dry, you may have combination skin.
- If your skin feels comfortable without excess oil or dryness, it is likely normal.

For a more personalized routine, consider completing the skin analysis on the Cure app, where your concerns will be reviewed, and a suitable care plan will be recommended based on your skin needs.
